ModMetaData.name: Shadow Charger Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces sarg.alphaanimals' AA_ShadowCharger art (primary look, south/east/north facings only - the AA_ShadowCharger_female, AA_ShadowCharger_baby and dessicated-corpse textures stay on donor art) with custom generated art. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_ShadowCharger/AA_ShadowCharger_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
Donor ships this art as loose PNGs already (not AssetBundle-packed), so this is a plain file overwrite by load order.
